headline: Loadshedding rises as Adani power plant unit shuts down due to technical fault
summary: Production has dropped to under 750MW after a boiler issue at the Jharkhand-based plant, worsening the national power crisis.
details: A technical fault caused one unit of the Adani power plant in Jharkhand, India, to shut down around midnight on Thursday, leading to increased loadshedding across Bangladesh.
caption:
Loadshedding is surging as a key unit of the Adani power plant shuts down due to a technical fault.

A technical fault caused one unit of the Adani power plant in Jharkhand, India, to shut down around midnight on Thursday, leading to increased loadshedding across Bangladesh.

headline: 63 foreigners detained in Chittagong for allegedly running a casino
summary: Police raided an eight-story building in the West Jalalabad area, recovering laptops and foreign currencies used for gambling operations.
details: Police detained 63 foreign nationals during a raid on an eight-story building in the West Jalalabad area of Khulshi police station in Chittagong.
The operation, conducted on Thursday night based on secret intelligence, targeted a building where foreigners were allegedly running an illegal gambling casino.
Among those detained are citizens of Laos, China, Pakistan, and Vietnam, according to police sources.
Authorities recovered more than 50 laptops, various foreign currencies, and other equipment used to operate the casino during the raid.
The detainees were transported from the building in police prison vans on Friday morning.
Local residents claimed that foreigners had been frequently visiting the building for about a month.
caption:
63 foreign nationals from four different countries detained in a single building in Chittagong.

Police detained 63 foreign nationals during a raid on an eight-story building in the West Jalalabad area of Khulshi police station in Chittagong.

The operation, conducted on Thursday night based on secret intelligence, targeted a building where foreigners were allegedly running an illegal gambling casino.

Among those detained are citizens of Laos, China, Pakistan, and Vietnam, according to police sources.

Authorities recovered more than 50 laptops, various foreign currencies, and other equipment used to operate the casino during the raid.

The detainees were transported from the building in police prison vans on Friday morning.

Local residents claimed that foreigners had been frequently visiting the building for about a month.
